guesses.reason: Small body, large erect triangular ears, rounded skull, short muzzle, and large dark eyes are classic Chihuahua traits.
The dark brindle-black coat with a white chin stripe, white chest blaze, and white foot suggests Boston Terrier-style tuxedo markings.
The lean legs, smooth short coat, and slightly longer muzzle with an alert terrier expression hint at Rat Terrier ancestry.

breed.appearance: A small, slender dog with a short, smooth coat of dark black-brindle with faint brown striping, plus a white chin, a white patch on the lower chest, and one fully white front paw and lower leg while the other front paw is dark with pale toe tips. Tall, upright, pointed triangular ears sit atop a rounded head with a moderately short muzzle, a black nose, faint gray frosting around the muzzle, and round dark brown eyes. Bonchon wears a bright blue collar with a silver bone-shaped ID tag and has a thin, dark tail.
breed.fun_fact: Chihuahuas are the smallest dog breed in the world but have huge personalities and are famously loyal to the people they love!
